messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.29-0 released
messages.body_plain:
A new package version (source and Windows binaries) is available from

  http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm


NEWS file entry:

v0.29-0  (2013-10-13)

  o new function 'drawdown'

  o Code examples in subdirectory 'NMOFex' (manual)
    updated.

  o small updates in documentation



To install from within R, type

  install.packages('NMOF', repos = 'http://enricoschumann.net/R')


I have also updated the manual, available from 

  http://enricoschumann.net/NMOF.htm#NMOFmanual 



-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
